## Public GitHub repositories and project entry points

- [agent-skills](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills) — public skill contracts, bounded agents, site generators, and resume source.
- [tau](https://github.com/grahama1970/tau) — receipt-gated multi-agent harness.
- [pdf_oxide fork](https://github.com/grahama1970/pdf_oxide) — document extraction and validation work.
- [persona-dream](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/persona-dream/README.md) — persona and voice experiment docs, run records, and evidence notes.
- [surf](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/surf/README.md) — browser-control skill contract, screenshots, and tab-provenance docs.
- [battle](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/battle/README.md) — red/blue exploit-evaluation sandbox docs.
- [t'au](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/tau/README.md) — agent-harness skill contract inside agent-skills.
- [extractor](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/extractor/README.md) — document-extraction skill contract and routing docs.
- [dogpile](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/dogpile/README.md) — multi-source research skill contract and provider-reporting docs.
- [watch](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/watch/README.md) — video-analysis skill contract and timestamped evidence docs.
- [scillm](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/scillm/README.md) — LLM gateway and model-routing skill docs.
- [debugger](https://github.com/grahama1970/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/debugger/README.md) — debugger skill contract for breakpoint-based runtime inspection.
- [sparta explorer](https://github.com/grahama1970/sparta-public) — public overview for SPARTA Explorer; private evidence is not published.
- [memory](https://github.com/grahama1970/memory-public) — BM25 + graph recall for agents

## Notes for agents

- Use /resume.md for exact resume text; use /ledger and /capabilities
  for generated skill and capability evidence.
- Use GitHub links for source-level inspection. Some links point to
  skill README files inside agent-skills rather than separate repos.
- Current/export-controlled client and program details are withheld by
  necessity, not omission.
- Every count on this site is generated from the repository at the deploy
  commit (b2a2b9235d), not hand-maintained.
